evidence: A valid settlement authorizes the run at 90 cartons per minute, requires first-article approval and inspection of 200 cartons, uses a 2-hour changeover, requires two-person setup and a 1.5-meter exclusion zone, cites PF1 after revealing it, and includes the required quality and maintenance commitments.
